caption: full moon in leo at 2.2°, 12:17 utc today. it looks full tonight and last night. look east after sunset.

slides.headline: full moon in *leo*, today. *say it* with your whole chest
the moon sits opposite the *sun*
slides.body: the sun is in aquarius, the moon across from it in leo, fully lit. it rises in the east around sunset and looks full tonight and last night.

slides.headline: your heart wants a *witness*
slides.body: astrologers read leo full moons as the need to be seen. jupiter is retrograde in leo too, so it's less about new and more about owning what's already true.

slides.headline: three signs feel this *full moon* most

rows.label: leo
rows.text: **your sign.** be seen for what you want.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: the moon faces you. a partner speaks up.

rows.label: taurus
rows.text: home or career: pick tonight's priority.

slides.headline: tell them *once*, out loud. not in a story.
slides.body: it has to be mutual, so ask, then listen.
